subject.statement: Charlie Javice was acquitted on all counts in March 2025, as per the verdict summary from S.D.N.Y. on 28 March 2025 in the case concerning the sale of Frank to JPMorgan Chase.
disambiguators: case concerning the sale of Frank to JPMorgan Chase

summary: News reports from March 2025 indicate that a federal jury in the Southern District of New York acquitted Charlie Javice on all counts in the criminal case concerning the sale of Frank to JPMorgan Chase, with the verdict dated 28 March 2025.
